definitions.explanation: an informal or rough pronoun referring to a third person who is distant from both speaker and listener

examples.japanese: あいつ⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{信用|しんよう}できない→信用する：25371_shinyousuru⟧。
あいつ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{言|い}った→言う：00515_iu⟧こと⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{本当|ほんとう}→本当：00779_hontou⟧だ。
examples.english: What that person said is true.

examples.japanese: あいつ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦もう→もう：00602_mou⟧⟦{二度|にど}と→二度と：06482_nidoto⟧⟦{会|あ}いたくない→会う：00482_au⟧。
examples.english: I never want to see that person again.

notes:
REGISTER:
Informal/rough. Can sound contemptuous or rude depending on context. Often used among male friends casually.

KO-SO-A-DO SYSTEM:
Part of the demonstrative pronoun system for people:
- ⟦こいつ→こいつ：08268_koitsu⟧ (this guy - near speaker)
- ⟦そいつ→そいつ：08759_soitsu⟧ (that guy - near listener)
- あいつ (that guy - distant from both)
- ⟦どいつ→どいつ：18614_doitsu⟧ (which guy - interrogative)

WRITING:
Can be written {彼奴|あいつ} but usually in hiragana.

USAGE:
- Casual/rough among friends: affectionate
- About strangers/enemies: contemptuous
- Neutral gender but often used for males

POLITE ALTERNATIVES:
- ⟦あの{人|ひと}→あの人：25922_anohito⟧ (that person - polite)
- ⟦あの{方|かた}→あの方：16618_anokata⟧ (that person - formal)
- ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧/⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧ (he/she - neutral)

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦こいつ→こいつ：08268_koitsu⟧ (this guy)
- ⟦そいつ→そいつ：08759_soitsu⟧ (that guy)
- ⟦どいつ→どいつ：18614_doitsu⟧ (which guy)
- ⟦あの{人|ひと}→あの人：25922_anohito⟧ (that person - polite)
